boundaries: Do not commit secrets or machine-specific configuration.
Do not perform destructive or externally visible actions without authority.
Never post GitHub reviews, comments, or approvals automatically; all publishing requires an explicit user action.
Do not manage or store auth tokens in the app; delegate authentication entirely to the gh and claude/codex CLIs.
Integrate with GitHub via the gh CLI and with AI via the claude/codex CLIs (no direct API keys).
